faq.q: Will Google penalise my AI-written blog?
faq.a: Not for using AI. Google targets mass-produced content made only to rank. Reviewed, accurate, genuinely useful content is fine regardless of how the first draft was written.
It can produce something that looks like a website quickly. Turning that into a site that converts, loads fast and reflects your brand is still the hard part, and it is still human work.

faq.q: Should I add an AI chatbot?
faq.a: Only if you have enough enquiry volume to justify it and real content for it to answer from. A chatbot that guesses is worse than a contact form that works.
